scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: ss 1(1)-(3C), 1A(1)-(3), 2, 3(1), (2), (2B), (2C), 3A, 5(1), (1ZA)-(1ZB), (1A)-(1C), 8(1)-(2), (4), Sch A1 paras 1, 4(2), 5, 10(2), of the revised text as at 1 May 2026. The two printed versions of s 5(1)(b) are a vintage input. Left out on purpose: penalties on conviction, s 4 agricultural employees, s 5A, ss 6-13, Schs 1-3 (see NOTES.md).

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-18 (tests-independent.l4, 124 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read); one failed (N38: s 5 applied to a service occupier) and the encoding was corrected (F10). Dates are computed as the Act words them, with no working-day rule. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: s 5(1)(b): the two printed versions are a vintage input, never merged.
forks.F2: 4 weeks before: effect on or after giving + 28.
forks.F3: two months before: corresponding date, or last day of the month.
forks.F4: (1ZA)(a)(i): an agreed period over two months, or not agreed with all joint tenants, falls back to (ii).
forks.F5: s 3(2C) saves tenancies only; s 3A(8) excludes licences only.
forks.F6: Statutorily protected tenancies: s 3 does not apply (protected by their own Acts); s 2 applies to any dwelling lease.
forks.F8: Sch A1 para 1(2): no last day while conduct continues (NOTHING).
forks.F9: 28 days beginning with the day after X end on X + 28; final notice from X + 29.
forks.F10: s 8(2) deems a service occupier a tenant for Part I only; s 5 applies to them only as a periodic licensee.
